facts.fact: Devan's count at the shelf: about fourteen hundred Thurai (sixty hulls, twenty-odd each) against forty-two odiyans, six of whom leave for Kodiyur next light, so thirty-six remain, plus forty garrison volunteers: seventy-six defenders. This replaces the outline's 'seventy odiyans', which conflicts with F740 (forty-two odiyans).
facts.why: needed because the outline's seventy odiyans cannot be true given the Company's size.

facts.fact: The Kodiyur party reached the shelf on foot with a pack pony at first light, and Neela stopped there to see Devan's wall plan; the scout attack delays their departure.
facts.why: needed because Neela must be present at the shelf in ch 8 although ch 7 ends with leaving at first light.

facts.fact: Bhaskaran's horn code for the queen's riders at the gate is two long notes, a short, and a long (distinct from F455's one long and two short for unarmed strangers). The horn carries down the cut from Kettamala to the lower narrows.
facts.why: needed because the beat ends on a code for crown riders and none was established.

facts.fact: Devan takes a shallow arrow graze along his left upper arm, shoulder to elbow; a matching welt rises on Neela's left forearm. The outline's 'since the snow' is rendered as 'since the night at the Resin House', as there is no snow in Varanad's rules.
facts.why: needed to anchor the consent question in a visible wound-share cost.

facts.fact: Devan kills a Thurai scout with a spear thrust before the man's blade rises, striking first for the first time in eight years. Four scouts die and two flee up the slope with Kandan's men in pursuit.
facts.why: needed to carry the beat 'You struck first.' 'Yes.'

facts.fact: The dead scout's purse holds eleven new Varanad silver coins, all with the doubled lowest pepper leaf, matching Parukutty's coin and weighing the same to a grain.
facts.why: needed to plant clue C08 (the shared die flaw).
